scope: Full first-pass screening of all 632 catalog model/variant records (576 product-family cards), including all 44 Purdue-designated profiles. This is a screening audit, not certification that every remaining model is current.
methodology: Screen all catalog identities; deduplicate identical manufacturer/model strings across categories.
Use targeted official-domain searches for successor, replacement, discontinued and newer-generation evidence; inspect existing model and manufacturer sources.
Manually verify positive relationships using manufacturer statements. Never infer succession only from larger capacity, higher model number, renamed branding, a parallel product or support status.
Record no-successor-confirmed and unresolved outcomes separately. A completed screen is not an exhaustive deep audit or a guarantee that no further successor exists.

Some direct page retrievals are blocked or unavailable; official indexed content is retained as evidence where accessible. Source checks are a dated snapshot and do not guarantee future link availability.
policy: Only manually verified direct successors or newer generations receive a badge. The badge does not itself claim discontinuation, unsupported status or interchangeability. Missing badges do not mean latest model.
